Settings.Title: Filler words
Settings.Hint: One word per line. Commas and semicolons are also accepted.
Settings.WordsDescription: Enter one word or phrase per line. Words that are real words in other languages, such as "um", are only removed when the dictation language matches.
Settings.CollapseRepeatedWordsDescriptio: Shortens a word that occurs three or more times in a row, such as "I I I", to a single word.
